what: segment flagged shower trajectory (segment_is_shower_trajectory) or shower topology (segment_is_shower_topology)
inputs: fit-point geometry, associated-point cloud RMS, median dQ/dx / MIP per 10 cm section, straightness, length (trajectory only <= 50 cm)
persisted: T_segment.flag_shower, length_cm, n_fit (not the RMS / dQ/dx)

what: dQ/dx-template competition (segment_do_track_pid): forward and backward KS-like score against muon, proton (and electron if length < 20 cm) templates, constant MIP; muon is the default
inputs: dQ/dx vector along the segment (internal units), compare range 35 then 15 cm, segment length, start_n / end_n (vertex degrees), npoints
persisted: T_segment.pdg (live, final), length_cm, n_fit; NOT the dQ/dx vector, the template scores or particle_score

what: if the template PID returned 0: median dQ/dx > 1.75 MIP -> proton; < 1.2 MIP -> muon; < 1.5 MIP and length < 4 cm -> muon
length < 1.5 cm and one end free: with the other end of degree > 2: proton (median > 1.75 MIP) or PION (median < 1.2 MIP), dirsign set toward the free end
length > 10 cm and 1.0 < particle_score < 100 -> pdg 11 (electron), score 200, dirsign 0
an electron-typed track with both ends occupied (start_n > 1 and end_n > 1), or a direction pointing into an occupied end, gets dir_weak and dirsign 0; if score < 0.15 the type becomes MUON
a shower-topology segment gets pdg 11 unconditionally; a shower-trajectory segment is forced to pdg 11 unless the track PID is electron
among the pdg-13 segments at the main vertex only the LONGEST whose far end has no proton neighbour stays muon; EVERY OTHER pdg-13 segment at that vertex is re-typed pion (211)
inputs: segment length, far-vertex neighbours' pdg, segments_in_long_muon

what: a pdg-0 segment whose far vertex carries a proton: median dQ/dx / MIP > 1.3 -> proton, else pion; a proton-typed segment with an electron-like in-shower daughter is re-examined (ratio 1.3 / 1.4)
proton-daughter pion (m_shower_proton_daughter_pion), muon at a multi-proton vertex -> pion (m_muon_multi_proton_pion), A5 hadronic shower tag -> pion (m_shower_hadronic_tag)
persisted: T_segment.pdg only; knob values of the production job NOT AUDITED (source defaults: off)

what: a track-typed member of a pi0 pair search window is stamped pion 211
a shower row's type = the shower's cached particle_type (or the live start-segment pdg if kine_shower_pdg_live); a shower whose start segment is track-typed is a 'shower' row typed muon/pion/proton

stage: entry into the single-photon shower set
what: only electron-typed (pdg 11) showers of the main vertex's shower set with E > 20 MeV are counted (shw_sp_n_20mev_showers); typing is necessary, not sufficient
